license_required.quote: any person practicing or offering to practice advanced, professional, or practical nursing in Illinois shall submit evidence that he or she is qualified to practice, and shall be licensed as provided under this Act.

issuing_authority.value: Department of Financial and Professional Regulation
issuing_authority.quote: "Department" means the Department of Financial and Professional Regulation.

name.value: Department of Financial and Professional Regulation
name.quote: "Department" means the Department of Financial and Professional Regulation.

type.quote: "Department" means the Department of Financial and Professional Regulation.

degree_required.value: Approved program of professional or practical nursing education (approved by the Department)
degree_required.quote: the applicant has graduated from a professional nursing education program approved by the Department or has been granted a certificate of completion of pre-licensure requirements from another United States jurisdiction

accrediting_body.value: national accrediting body for nursing education recognized by the United States Department of Education and approved by the Department
accrediting_body.quote: beginning December 31, 2022, obtaining and maintaining programmatic accreditation by a national accrediting body for nursing education recognized by the United States Department of Education and approved by the Department.

degree_level.quote: the applicant has graduated from a practical nursing education program approved by the Department

school_approval_basis.quote: programs of professional or practical nursing, respectively, approved by the Department under the provisions of this Act.

credential_pegged.quote: the applicant has successfully completed a licensure examination approved by the Department

tiers.quote: the applicant has graduated from a practical nursing education program approved by the Department
the applicant has graduated from a professional nursing education program approved by the Department

the applicant has obtained a graduate degree appropriate for national certification in a clinical advanced practice registered nursing specialty or a graduate degree or post-master's certificate from a graduate level program in a clinical advanced practice registered nursing specialty

required.quote: the applicant has graduated from a professional nursing education program approved by the Department

experience_source.quote: the applicant has graduated from a professional nursing education program approved by the Department

exams.name: Department-approved licensure examination (RN)
exams.notes: Commonly the NCLEX-RN; statute references NCLEX preparatory class for those who fail or delay taking it.
exams.quote: the applicant has successfully completed a licensure examination approved by the Department

exams.name: Department-approved licensure examination (LPN)
exams.quote: the applicant has successfully completed a licensure examination approved by the Department

exams.name: National certification examination (APRN)
exams.notes: Applicant must hold and maintain current national certification as a CNM, CNS, CNP, or CRNA from the appropriate national certifying body as determined by rule.
exams.quote: the applicant has successfully completed requirements to practice as, and holds and maintains current, national certification as, a nurse midwife, clinical nurse specialist, nurse practitioner, or certified registered nurse anesthetist from the appropriate national certifying body as determined by rule of the Department

required.quote: The Department shall adopt rules of continuing education for persons licensed under this Article as advanced practice registered nurses that require 80 hours of continuing education per 2-year license renewal cycle.

hours_per_period.quote: require 80 hours of continuing education per 2-year license renewal cycle

period_years.quote: 80 hours of continuing education per 2-year license renewal cycle

value: minimum 50 hours in continuing education programs including no less than 20 hours of pharmacotherapeutics, including 10 hours of opioid prescribing or substance abuse education (APRN)
maximum 30 hours by presentations, evidence-based practice, quality improvement projects, publications, research, or preceptor hours (APRN)
20 hours per 2-year cycle for RN (may be adopted by rule)
20 hours per 2-year cycle for LPN (may be adopted by rule)
topical_requirements.quote: A minimum of 50 hours of the continuing education shall be obtained in continuing education programs as determined by rule that shall include no less than 20 hours of pharmacotherapeutics, including 10 hours of opioid prescribing or substance abuse education.

available.quote: An applicant for licensure by endorsement who is a licensed practical nurse licensed by examination under the laws of another United States jurisdiction or a foreign jurisdiction is eligible for licensure when the following requirements are met

requirements.value: Licensure by endorsement available for RNs and LPNs licensed in another US or foreign jurisdiction who meet education and examination requirements and pass criminal history check. Temporary permits available pending full licensure.
requirements.quote: the applicant has been issued a licensed practical nurse license by another United States or foreign jurisdiction, which shall be verified, as defined by rule

exists.quote: The Secretary shall solicit recommendations from nursing organizations and appoint the Board of Nursing, which shall consist of 13 members

national_certification.value: National certifying body for CNM, CNS, CNP, CRNA (as determined by Department rule)
national_certification.quote: holds and maintains current, national certification as, a nurse midwife, clinical nurse specialist, nurse practitioner, or certified registered nurse anesthetist from the appropriate national certifying body as determined by rule of the Department

regulatory_model.quote: No person shall practice or offer to practice advanced, professional, or practical nursing in Illinois or use any title, sign, card or device to indicate that such a person is practicing professional or practical nursing unless such person has been licensed under the provisions of this Act.

credential_type.quote: any person practicing or offering to practice advanced, professional, or practical nursing in Illinois shall submit evidence that he or she is qualified to practice, and shall be licensed as provided under this Act.

is_mandatory.quote: No person shall practice or offer to practice advanced, professional, or practical nursing in Illinois or use any title, sign, card or device to indicate that such a person is practicing professional or practical nursing unless such person has been licensed under the provisions of this Act.

title_protection.quote: Only a registered nurse licensed under this Act is entitled to use the titles "registered nurse" and "registered professional nurse" and the abbreviation, "R.N.".

scope_protection.quote: No person shall: Practice as an advanced practice registered nurse without a valid license as an advanced practice registered nurse... Practice professional nursing without a valid license as a registered professional nurse... Practice practical nursing without a valid license as a licensed practical nurse

disciplinary_grounds.description: Material deception in furnishing information to the Department.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Material deception in furnishing information to the Department.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Material violations of any provision of this Act or violation of rules or final administrative action of the Secretary.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Material violations of any provision of this Act or violation of the rules of or final administrative action of the Secretary, after consideration of the recommendation of the Board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or of a misdemeanor involving dishonesty or directly related to nursing practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction by plea of guilty or nolo contendere, finding of guilt, jury verdict, or entry of judgment or by sentencing of any crime... that is a felony; or that is a misdemeanor, an essential element of which is dishonesty, or that is directly related to the practice of the profession.

disciplinary_grounds.description: A pattern of practice or other behavior demonstrating incapacity or incompetency to practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A pattern of practice or other behavior which demonstrates incapacity or incompetency to practice under this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly aiding or assisting another person in violating any provision of this Act or rules.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly aiding or assisting another person in violating any provision of this Act or rules.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing within 90 days to provide a response to a written request for information by the Department.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing, within 90 days, to provide a response to a request for information in response to a written request made by the Department by certified or registered mail or by email to the email address of record.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in dishonorable, unethical, or unprofessional conduct likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in dishonorable, unethical, or unprofessional conduct of a character likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public, as defined by rule.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unlawful taking, theft, selling, distributing, or manufacturing of any drug, narcotic, or prescription device.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unlawful taking, theft, selling, distributing, or manufacturing of any drug, narcotic, or prescription device.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual or excessive use or addiction to alcohol, narcotics, or other chemical agents that could result in inability to practice safely.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitual or excessive use or addiction to alcohol, narcotics, stimulants, or any other chemical agent or drug that could result in a licensee's inability to practice with reasonable judgment, skill, or safety.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Discipline by another US jurisdiction or foreign nation for substantially equivalent grounds.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Discipline by another U.S. jurisdiction or foreign nation, if at least one of the grounds for the discipline is the same or substantially equivalent to those set forth in this Section.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating the terms of probation or conditions placed on the license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A finding that the licensee, after having her or his license placed on probationary status or subject to conditions or restrictions, has violated the terms of probation or failed to comply with such terms or conditions.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being named as a perpetrator in an indicated child abuse or neglect report with clear and convincing evidence.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being named as a perpetrator in an indicated report by the Department of Children and Family Services and under the Abused and Neglected Child Reporting Act, and upon proof by clear and convincing evidence that the licensee has caused a child to be an abused child or neglected child

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful omission to file or record, or willfully impeding the filing of, medical reports required by law.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful omission to file or record, or willfully impeding the filing or recording or inducing another person to omit to file or record medical reports as required by law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully failing to report suspected child abuse or neglect as required by the Abused and Neglected Child Reporting Act.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully failing to report an instance of suspected child abuse or neglect as required by the Abused and Neglected Child Reporting Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross negligence in the practice of practical, professional, or advanced practice registered nursing.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gross negligence in the practice of practical, professional, or advanced practice registered nursing.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Holding oneself out to be practicing nursing under any name other than one's own.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Holding oneself out to be practicing nursing under any name other than one's own.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to report to the Department any adverse final action taken by another licensing jurisdiction, peer review body, health care institution, or professional association.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure of a licensee to report to the Department any adverse final action taken against him or her by another licensing jurisdiction of the United States or any foreign state or country, any peer review body, any health care institution, any professional or nursing society or association, any governmental agency, any law enforcement agency, or any court

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to report surrender of a license or authorization to practice in another jurisdiction while under disciplinary investigation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure of a licensee to report to the Department surrender by the licensee of a license or authorization to practice nursing or advanced practice registered nursing in another state or jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to establish and maintain records of patient care and treatment as required by law.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to establish and maintain records of patient care and treatment as required by law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud, deceit, or misrepresentation in applying for or procuring a license or in applying for renewal.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud, deceit, or misrepresentation in applying for or procuring a license under this Act or in connection with applying for renewal of a license under this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Allowing another person or organization to use the licensee's license to deceive the public.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Allowing another person or organization to use the licensee's license to deceive the public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully making or filing false records or reports in the licensee's practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully making or filing false records or reports in the licensee's practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Attempting to subvert or cheat on a licensing examination.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Attempting to subvert or cheat on a licensing examination administered under this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Immoral conduct in the commission of an act including sexual abuse, sexual misconduct, or sexual exploitation related to the licensee's practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Immoral conduct in the commission of an act, including, but not limited to, sexual abuse, sexual misconduct, or sexual exploitation, related to the licensee's practice.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully or negligently violating the confidentiality between nurse and patient except as required by law.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully or negligently violating the confidentiality between nurse and patient except as required by law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing under a false or assumed name, except as provided by law.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing under a false or assumed name, except as provided by law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of any false, fraudulent, or deceptive statement in any document connected with the licensee's practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The use of any false, fraudulent, or deceptive statement in any document connected with the licensee's practice.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Directly or indirectly giving to or receiving from any person a fee, commission, rebate, or other compensation for professional services not actually rendered.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Directly or indirectly giving to or receiving from a person, firm, corporation, partnership, or association a fee, commission, rebate, or other form of compensation for professional services not actually or personally rendered.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Physical illness, mental illness, or disability resulting in inability to practice with reasonable judgment, skill, or safety.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Physical illness, mental illness, or disability that results in the inability to practice the profession with reasonable judgment, skill, or safety.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Exceeding the terms of a collaborative agreement or prescriptive authority delegated under a written collaborative agreement.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Exceeding the terms of a collaborative agreement or the prescriptive authority delegated to a licensee by his or her collaborating physician or podiatric physician in guidelines established under a written collaborative agreement.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making a false or misleading statement regarding a licensee's skill or the efficacy of medicine or treatment prescribed.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making a false or misleading statement regarding a licensee's skill or the efficacy or value of the medicine, treatment, or remedy prescribed by him or her in the course of treatment.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, selling, administering, distributing, giving, or self-administering a controlled substance for other than medically accepted therapeutic purposes.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing, selling, administering, distributing, giving, or self-administering a drug classified as a controlled substance (designated product) or narcotic for other than medically accepted therapeutic purposes.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Promotion of the sale of drugs, devices, appliances, or goods in a manner to exploit the patient for financial gain.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Promotion of the sale of drugs, devices, appliances, or goods provided for a patient in a manner to exploit the patient for financial gain.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating State or federal laws, rules, or regulations relating to controlled substances.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating State or federal laws, rules, or regulations relating to controlled substances.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully failing to report suspected abuse, neglect, financial exploitation, or self-neglect of an eligible adult under the Adult Protective Services Act.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully failing to report an instance of suspected abuse, neglect, financial exploitation, or self-neglect of an eligible adult as defined in and required by the Adult Protective Services Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being named as an abuser in a verified report under the Adult Protective Services Act with clear and convincing evidence.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being named as an abuser in a verified report by the Department on Aging and under the Adult Protective Services Act, and upon proof by clear and convincing evidence that the licensee abused, neglected, or financially exploited an eligible adult

insurance_required.quote: evidence of general and professional liability insurance in the amounts of at least $1,000,000 per incident and $3,000,000 in aggregate and workers' compensation coverage for all nurses or certified nursing aides employed, assigned, or referred by the nurse agency to a health care facility

establishment_regulation_required.quote: No person may establish, operate, maintain, or advertise as a nurse agency in the State of Illinois unless the person is licensed under this Act by the Department of Labor.

definition_quote.value: Registered professional nursing practice means a scientific process founded on a professional body of knowledge that includes, but is not limited to, the protection, promotion, and optimization of health and abilities, prevention of illness and injury, development and implementation of the nursing plan of care, facilitation of nursing interventions to alleviate suffering, care coordination, and advocacy in the care of individuals, families, groups, communities, and populations.
definition_quote.quote: "Registered professional nursing practice" means a scientific process founded on a professional body of knowledge that includes, but is not limited to, the protection, promotion, and optimization of health and abilities, prevention of illness and injury, development and implementation of the nursing plan of care, facilitation of nursing interventions to alleviate suffering, care coordination, and advocacy in the care of individuals, families, groups, communities, and populations.

value: ordering treatments and applying medical devices (APRN)
methods_authorized.quote: Practice as a registered professional nurse means this full scope of nursing, with or without compensation, that incorporates caring for all patients in all settings, through nursing standards of practice and professional performance for coordination of care

drug_authority.value: APRNs may prescribe medications including Schedule III-V controlled substances under a written collaborative agreement; APRNs with full practice authority may prescribe Schedule II-V controlled substances (with consultation for Schedule II narcotics such as opioids). CRNAs may select, order, and administer controlled substances for anesthesia. LPNs and RNs administer medications as delegated.
drug_authority.quote: to possess the authority to prescribe medications, including Schedule II through V controlled substances, as provided in Section 65-43.

value: Advanced Practice Registered Nurse (APRN) - Certified Nurse Midwife (CNM)
Advanced Practice Registered Nurse (APRN) - Certified Nurse Practitioner (CNP)
Advanced Practice Registered Nurse (APRN) - Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetist (CRNA)
Advanced Practice Registered Nurse (APRN) - Clinical Nurse Specialist (CNS)
license_tiers.quote: "Advanced practice registered nurse" or "APRN" means a person who has met the qualifications for a (i) certified nurse midwife (CNM); (ii) certified nurse practitioner (CNP); (iii) certified registered nurse anesthetist (CRNA); or (iv) clinical nurse specialist (CNS) and has been licensed by the Department.

aprn_role_categories.quote: "Advanced practice registered nurse" or "APRN" means a person who has met the qualifications for a (i) certified nurse midwife (CNM); (ii) certified nurse practitioner (CNP); (iii) certified registered nurse anesthetist (CRNA); or (iv) clinical nurse specialist (CNS) and has been licensed by the Department.

value: other health care professional determined by the Department
lpn_supervision_requirements.quote: Practice as a licensed practical nurse means a scope of nursing practice, with or without compensation, under the guidance of a registered professional nurse or an advanced practice registered nurse, or as directed by a physician assistant, physician, dentist, podiatric physician, or other health care professionals as determined by the Department

collaborative_practice_agreement_require.quote: A written collaborative agreement is required for all advanced practice registered nurses engaged in clinical practice prior to meeting the requirements of Section 65-43, except for advanced practice registered nurses who are privileged to practice in a hospital, hospital affiliate, or ambulatory surgical treatment center.

full_independent_practice_available.quote: An Illinois-licensed advanced practice registered nurse certified as a nurse practitioner, nurse midwife, or clinical nurse specialist shall be deemed by law to possess the ability to practice without a written collaborative agreement as set forth in this Section.

full_independent_practice_experience_hou.quote: an advanced practice registered nurse certified as a nurse midwife, clinical nurse specialist, or nurse practitioner who files with the Department a notarized attestation of completion of at least 250 hours of continuing education or training in the advanced practice registered nurse's area of certification and at least 4,000 hours of clinical experience after first attaining national certification

approximate.matched_normalized: advanced practice registered nurse certified as a nurse midwife clinical nurse specialist or nurse practitioner who files with the department a notarized attestation of completion of at least 250 hours of continuing education or training in the advanced practice registered nurse s area of certification and at least 4 000 hours of clinical experience after first attaining national certification

prescriptive_authority_certificate_requi.quote: To prescribe controlled substances under this Section, an advanced practice registered nurse must obtain a mid-level practitioner controlled substance license.

value: Schedule II (oral or topical/transdermal only, with consultation for opioids, under full practice authority)
controlled_substance_schedule_authority.quote: authority to prescribe both legend drugs and Schedule II through V controlled substances

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: Under full practice authority, APRNs may prescribe Schedule II narcotic drugs (such as opioids) only in a consultation relationship with a physician; must be recorded in the Prescription Monitoring Program; specific Schedule II narcotic must be identified by brand or generic name; may be administered by oral dosage or topical/transdermal application only (no injection); APRN and physician must discuss patients for whom opioids are prescribed at least monthly.
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: prescribing Schedule II narcotic drugs, such as opioids, only in a consultation relationship with a physician; this consultation relationship shall be recorded in the Prescription Monitoring Program website

dea_registration_required.quote: authority to obtain an Illinois controlled substance license and a federal Drug Enforcement Administration number

controlled_substance_database_registrati.quote: this consultation relationship shall be recorded in the Prescription Monitoring Program website, pursuant to Section 316 of the Illinois Controlled Substances Act, by the physician and advanced practice registered nurse with full practice authority

delegation_to_unlicensed_personnel_autho.quote: in community-based or in-home care settings, delegate the administration of medication (limited to oral or subcutaneous dosage and topical or transdermal application) to unlicensed personnel, if all the conditions for delegation set forth in this Section are met

employer_mandatory_reporting_required.quote: Any nurse who is an administrator or officer in any hospital, nursing home, other health care agency or facility, or nurse agency and has knowledge of any action or condition which reasonably indicates that a registered professional nurse or licensed practical nurse is impaired due to the use of alcohol or mood altering drugs... shall promptly report the individual to the Department

whistleblower_protection_for_delegation_.quote: A nurse shall not be subject to disciplinary or any other adverse action for refusing to delegate a nursing intervention based on patient safety.

impaired_nurse_alternative_program_avail.quote: "Professional assistance program for nurses" means a professional assistance program that meets criteria established by the Board of Nursing and approved by the Secretary, which provides a non-disciplinary treatment approach for nurses licensed under this Act whose ability to practice is compromised by alcohol or chemical substance addiction.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: Temporary permits for out-of-state APRNs authorize practice via telehealth at specified locations. Full practice authority APRNs may practice via telehealth consistent with their permit or license.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: The temporary permit shall only permit the holder to practice as a full practice advanced practice registered nurse within the scope of providing health care services at the location or locations specified on the permit or via telehealth service.

nurse_practitioner_transition_to_practic.quote: at least 4,000 hours of clinical experience after first attaining national certification

crna_physician_supervision_model.quote: an anesthesiologist, a physician, a dentist, or a podiatric physician must participate through discussion of and agreement with the anesthesia plan and remain physically present and available on the premises during the delivery of anesthesia services for diagnosis, consultation, and treatment of emergency medical conditions.

cnm_out_of_hospital_birth_authorized.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse certified as a nurse midwife may provide out-of-hospital birth services in a licensed birth center without a written collaborative agreement if the advanced practice registered nurse certified as a nurse midwife is granted clinical privileges for out-of-hospital birth services by the clinical director of the birth center.
